name: Bohemian Switzerland in a day
description_md:
This one day city sightseeing walk is anchored in Bohemian Switzerland in CZ. The route features five sightseeing stops connected by 13.5 km of walking between stops.

The full day takes about 7.7 hours, which includes the visit time at each stop.
